project_title: Eduardo Rivero Rector - USFX 2026-2030 Campaign PWA
design_context: Mobile-First Progressive Web App (PWA) with Gamified Campaign Ecosystem
theme: Light theme with institutional blue accents

mascot_identity.name: El Oso
mascot_identity.usage: Integrated in header badges, game branding (Ruleta de El Oso, Trivia Express #NuestraVisión), wallet coin icons, and interactive rewards.

layout_and_navigation.header: Top bar featuring 'Eduardo Rivero Rector', official USFX campaign badge, mascot icon 'El Oso', coin balance pill with quick action link, and admin access shortcut.

ruleta_50_50.title: La Ruleta de El Oso
ruleta_50_50.mechanism: 50/50 color selection (Azul / Dorado), bet coins, x2 payout on win, x0 on loss.
ruleta_50_50.visuals: Animated CSS conic-gradient wheel with smooth spin-to-stop rotation, victory confetti sound and animations.

trivia_express.title: Trivia Express #NuestraVisión
trivia_express.mechanism: 5 questions in 10-second fast round regarding campaign proposals, university history, and science innovation. Correct answers yield x1.5 coins multiplier.
trivia_express.visuals: 10-second radial progress timer bar, instant tactile haptic-style feedback, score recap popup.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rule: All interactive buttons, input fields, navigation links, game controls, and balance indicators MUST include a explicit data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first responsive PWA layout with a polished bottom navigation bar for quick access on smartphones.
Implement real JWT authentication on FastAPI with passlib (bcrypt) and PyJWT. Support both regular student user registration/login and seed an admin account.
Implement atomic MongoDB operations for balance deductions and payouts to guarantee zero race conditions during roulette spins and trivia reward claims.
Maintain high visual standard using institutional blue #0B3C5D, crisp white cards, smooth glassmorphic header blur, and distinct mascot integration for El Oso.
Ensure the admin panel allows adding, editing, and deleting rewards dynamically, initial state starting with empty or manageable rewards list as specified.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all essential UI components.
